hooks.name: lint-on-save
hooks.description: UNVERIFIED FORMAT: replace with the file Kiro writes when recreated in the Agent Hooks UI. After the agent saves a TS/TSX file, run cached ESLint (fast, path-free). Type-checking is deliberately NOT run on every save: mid-task, types are temporarily inconsistent across files.

hooks.name: typecheck-after-task
hooks.description: UNVERIFIED FORMAT and trigger name (see above). After each spec task finishes, type-check the whole project. If the Kiro IDE has no post-task trigger, move this to an agent-stop trigger or drop it and rely on the task checkpoints.
